logos.r5-01: Heartbeat on a screen — the $30/month 'your site stays up' promise, drawn.
logos.r5-02: A shop awning. Speaks directly to the small-business owner, not to designers.
logos.r5-03: Three connected points — one brand joined up across every touchpoint.
logos.r5-04: Two squares coming into register — alignment, borrowed from print.
logos.r5-05: Two rising chevrons. Growth, without shouting — no bold-and-energetic.
logos.r5-06: A map pin — local and findable, which is what the $2000/month SEO sells.
logos.r5-07: A sprout. A small business growing, and the softest shape of the ten.
logos.r5-08: Two fields blending where they meet — brand and web as one thing.
logos.r5-09: A browser window. The most literal of the ten: this is what you get for $500.
logos.r5-10: A four-point spark — polish and quality. Light type, wide tracking, quietest.
